qa_pair.question: Use the linkedin_format_post tool to audit the text "Innovating with AI in 2026 #AI #Tech". How many hashtags does the tool detect? Respond with a single integer.

Format the string "**Antigravity**" using the linkedin_format_post tool with convert_markdown set to true. Does the resulting cleanFormattedText contain standard ASCII asterisks? Respond True or False.
Audit a short 50-character single-line post using the linkedin_format_post tool. What is the cutoffRisk level assigned to its hook? Respond low, medium, or high.
According to the linkedin_format_post tool output, what is the maximum character limit (maxCharacters) permitted for a LinkedIn post? Respond with a single integer.
Inspect the scheduled posts using linkedin_list_scheduled_posts filtering by status 'cancelled'. What is the count field returned in the structuredContent? Respond with an integer.
Audit the text "Partagez votre avis en commentaire ci-dessous 👇" using linkedin_format_post. Is hasCallToAction reported as True or False? Respond True or False.
Audit the text "Architecture logicielle et benchmarks microservices." using linkedin_format_post. Is hasCallToAction reported as True or False? Respond True or False.

Attempting to call linkedin_format_post with an empty text argument ("") triggers an input validation error because the minimum string length required by the schema is what value? Respond with a single integer.

Audit a post containing 7 hashtags: "#one #two #three #four #five #six #seven". Does the hashtags recommendations list advise reducing the hashtags to prevent algorithmic spam penalty? Respond True or False.
What is the maximum number of characters evaluated in the previewText before the fold by the hook analyzer in linkedin_format_post? Respond with a single integer.
